# SEO Optimization Skill for Muse

Teaches your agent to run evidence-led SEO audits instead of guessing: live Lighthouse SEO and Agentic Browsing checks via Chrome DevTools MCP (with a CLI fallback), then the signals Lighthouse can't see on its own — response headers, redirects, robots.txt, sitemap coverage, canonical consistency across templates, and structured-data eligibility. Covers crawlability (robots.txt, meta robots, canonicals), XML sitemaps, HTTPS and security headers, on-page work (title tags, meta descriptions, heading hierarchy, image SEO, descriptive internal linking), mobile SEO, hreflang for international sites, and a full SEO audit checklist sorted by priority. Especially current: a whole section on agentic browsing and AI discoverability — which crawler bots do what (OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, Claude-SearchBot, Google-Extended), training controls vs search controls, and why llms.txt is an optional experimental proposal, not a ranking factor. Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: it is a disciplined audit method, not a ranking button — it explicitly refuses to invent ranking-factor weights or promise ranking changes, and it treats a Lighthouse SEO score as a useful subset of checks, not a prediction of rankings; indexation outcomes always stay with the search engines. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
